sloka: स भ्रातुः शासनम् श्रुत्वा सर्वम् अप्रतिकूलयन् ।आरोप्य मैथिलीम् पूर्वम् आरुरोह आत्मवाम्स् ततः ॥२-५२-७६॥
transliteration: sa bhrātuḥ śāsanam śrutvā sarvam apratikūlayan ।āropya maithilīm pūrvam āruroha ātmavāms tataḥ ॥2-52-76॥

translations.english: Having heard his brother's command the selfcontrolled Lakshmana did as he was told.He first helped Sita get into the boat and thereafter boarded it himself.
